findings.summary: No drill file in gerber set
findings.description: No Excellon drill file found. PCB fabrication requires drill data.
findings.recommendation: Include drill file(s) in gerber export.

findings.summary: B paste layer: 127 flashes vs 272 copper (47%)
findings.description: B-side paste layer has significantly fewer flashes (127) than copper layer (272). This may indicate missing solder paste apertures.
findings.recommendation: Check solder paste aperture generation — missing apertures cause assembly defects.
